sql: SELECT state_abbr, SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2026 AND "month"=5 THEN persons_participating END) may26 FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE state_abbr='GA' GROUP BY state_abbr
reason: Warehouse May level already about 1.19M; article's May base does not reconcile.

assertion: National enrollment has now declined for 16 consecutive months since March 2025.

sql: SELECT "year","month",SUM(persons_participating) FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE "year" IN (2025,2026) GROUP BY "year","month" ORDER BY "year","month"
